title: Music service chips: label-in-name follow-ups from the RF-173 review
acceptance: The word break between a chip's service name and its state no longer rests on a space-only JSX text node a reflow could drop: a sturdier separator, or no aria-label, with a unit test that fails if the visible text runs the two together.
The reconnect chip's busy state ('Reconnecting…') keeps its visible text inside its accessible name, or the record says why the disabled state is exempt.
The expired-chip branch reuses the shared chip shell classes instead of copying them, and drops the aria-label that only repeats its visible text.

evidence.summary: Non-blocking findings from the RF-173 pre-PR review, not fixed in that PR.
Owner, 2026-11-06 in the Neo session: "Approve with defaults" for RF-200, RF-199 and RF-201 this session.
RF-200 fix; draft PR is the claim.

Music: the SoundCloud chip’s textContent is "SoundCloud Catalog only" with a space (regression guard). Reconnect: while busy the button is named "Reconnecting… SoundCloud" and disabled; failed before the fix (name stayed "Reconnect SoundCloud"). The reconnect chip’s select button is found by its visible name /^SoundCloud$/.

Deployed to production on 2026-11-07 from the Air: main f55b449a (#728, #744, #746, #745; records #743, #747), Worker 1d95a679-c9c3-4eb4-8371-980147c53a37, SPA assets/index-BVZTM4Zz.js, rollback ce487041-27d5-4edf-90e2-a6676522574e (75f09a1). No migrations. Smoke, headers and a 5-minute tail (0 exceptions) passed. Owner approval recorded before the deploy: https://github.com/steven-crosby/ritmofit-web/pull/746#issuecomment-6710041751. #744 for RF-200 is in that build. CI uses mock providers; this proves the deploy, not device behaviour.

resolution: All three items met on #744 (Neo, 2026-11-06). (1) The space between a chip’s service name and its state is now the trailing character of the name span’s own text (`${name} `), not a lone JSX space node, and the aria-label stays the exact name ("SoundCloud, Catalog only"). Dropping the aria-label was tried first, but a hidden separator in its own element is trimmed by the name computation ("SoundCloud,Catalog only"), so the exact aria-label stays. A unit test fails if the visible text runs the two together. (2) The reconnect button’s name starts with its visible text in both states: "Reconnect SoundCloud" and, while busy, "Reconnecting… SoundCloud". (3) The reconnect chip uses the shared pill classes (one `pill` plus a `width` string on its wrapper) instead of a copy, and its select button has no aria-label that only repeated its visible name.
